description: Read-only production catalog contract for the living publish columns; not a full schema reconstruction.

constraints.name: curations_application_deadline_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((application_deadline_kind IS NULL) AND (application_deadline_on IS NULL)) OR ((application_deadline_kind = 'fixed'::text) AND (application_deadline_on IS NOT NULL)) OR ((application_deadline_kind = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'closed'::text])) AND (application_deadline_on IS NULL))))

constraints.name: curations_content_ja_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((content_ja IS NULL) OR (((char_length(content_ja) >= 1) AND (char_length(content_ja) <= 200000)) AND (content_ja = btrim(content_ja)))))

constraints.name: curations_content_ko_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((content_ko IS NULL) OR (((char_length(content_ko) >= 1) AND (char_length(content_ko) <= 200000)) AND (content_ko = btrim(content_ko)))))

constraints.name: curations_source_image_url_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((source_image_url IS NULL) OR ((machimoa_review.safe_source_image_url(source_image_url) IS NOT NULL) AND (source_image_url = machimoa_review.safe_source_image_url(source_image_url)))))

constraints.name: curations_summary_ja_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((summary_ja IS NULL) OR (((char_length(summary_ja) >= 1) AND (char_length(summary_ja) <= 1000)) AND (summary_ja = btrim(summary_ja)))))

constraints.name: curations_summary_ko_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((summary_ko IS NULL) OR (((char_length(summary_ko) >= 1) AND (char_length(summary_ko) <= 1000)) AND (summary_ko = btrim(summary_ko)))))

constraints.name: curations_title_ja_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((title_ja IS NULL) OR (((char_length(title_ja) >= 1) AND (char_length(title_ja) <= 300)) AND (title_ja = btrim(title_ja)))))

constraints.name: curations_title_ko_length_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((title_ko IS NULL) OR (((char_length(title_ko) >= 1) AND (char_length(title_ko) <= 300)) AND (title_ko = btrim(title_ko)))))

constraints.name: curations_user_category_period_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((user_category IS NULL) AND (event_start_on IS NULL) AND (event_end_on IS NULL)) OR ((user_category = ANY (ARRAY['policy'::text, 'program'::text])) AND (application_deadline_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (event_start_on IS NULL) AND (event_end_on IS NULL)) OR ((user_category = 'event'::text) AND (application_deadline_kind IS NULL) AND (event_start_on IS NOT NULL) AND (event_end_on IS NOT NULL) AND (event_start_on <= event_end_on)) OR ((user_category = ANY (ARRAY['youth_space'::text, 'living'::text])) AND (application_deadline_kind IS NULL) AND (event_start_on IS NULL) AND (event_end_on IS NULL))))
